title: Boulder Bear
shortDescription: Help a brave teddy dodge, jump and ride boulders rolling down a mountain.
description: Boulders are rolling down three mountain trails toward a brave teddy bear. Change trails to dodge them, jump over single boulders, or land on top of a four-boulder train and ride it. The boulders speed up the longer you survive.
howToPlay: Change trails to get out of a boulder's way.
Land on top of a four-boulder train and ride it; only its front can knock you over.
Survive as long as you can. Every boulder that rolls past is worth 10 points.
